text:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: release 2.7.2 -> us-west-1 slice 12% breached p95 latency (465ms > 350ms). Auto-rollback in 5m unless acknowledged. :rotating_light:

kai.sre: saw the spike; traces point to decode tail on long-context requests.

maya.eng: pinging @jen-releases. There's a small group of VIP routes in that slice; prefer surgical mitigation.

jen-releases: proposals: 1) full rollback to 2.7.1 (fast), 2) pin VIPs to 2.7.1 and shrink canary, 3) toggle runtime flag `attn_fuse=false`. Which lowest impact?

ops-runner: we can pin VIPs quickly: `releasesctl route pin --customer vip-enterprise --to 2.7.1 --duration 24h` and shrink canary: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.2 --slice us-west-1 --percent 2`. Then ack to suppress auto-rollback.

kai.sre: do that now. I want time to run a scoped flag toggle probe.

ops-runner: applied pin and set percent -> 2%.

deploy-bot: Manual ack recorded by kai.sre; hold expires at 1755696900. Auto-rollback suppressed for 30m.

maya.eng: toggling flag on a small pool `staging-attn-1`: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.7.2 --name attn_fuse --value false --scope staging-attn-1` then run 1k synthetic requests.

ops-runner: probe results: p95=305ms, no 5xx. Extending hold by @kai.sre for 45m to validate.

jen-releases: if stable, ramp to 10% over 12m and keep VIP pin until patch ship. Fallback rollback command below if regression returns:

```
releasesctl rollback --from 2.7.2 --to 2.7.1 --regions us-west-1 --mode staged
notify --channel customer-ops --template rollback-latency-brief
```

maya.eng: ramp executed to 10% over 12m; monitoring shows p95 ~320ms. No rollback required.

kai.sre: creating follow-up REL-5480 to gate `attn_fuse` behind preflight and add long-seq regression. Creating incident for audit: INC-1998.

jen-releases: posted short customer note: "Reduced rollout in us-west-1 for latency checks; VIPs pinned to previous stable version. No action required."

deploy-bot: Final: auto-rollback suppressed; no rollback executed. Handoff REL-5480 and INC-1998. Thread closed.
